articles.title: U.S. government digital dollar set to be banned tonight under housing law's CBDC limit
articles.snippet: Despite President Donald Trump's refusal to sign Congress' bipartisan housing bill, it's set to go into effect at midnight, and its temporary CBDC ban along with it.

articles.title: Hyundai becomes first major South Korean company to introduce internal stablecoin transfers
articles.snippet: The initiative builds on a broader shift by companies exploring stablecoins to move money between international operations more efficiently.

articles.title: Metaplanet explores bringing bitcoin-backed digital credit to Japan
articles.snippet: The bitcoin treasury company is working with JPYC and Progmat to explore tokenized credit products backed by bitcoin, aiming to create efficient, 24/7 credit markets in Japan.

articles.title: Bitcoin zips higher to nearly $64,000 as chip rally and yen strength drive gains
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is up 4.2% over seven days that contained an oil shock, a bond selloff and two rounds of U.S. strikes on Iran.

articles.title: New Hampshire snuffs out trailblazing state-government bitcoin bond effort
articles.snippet: At its last stage for government approval, the state's executive council rejected the bond project 3-2.
